items.story: ഹ്യുണ്ടായ് മോട്ടോർ ഇന്ത്യ പുതിയൊരു മിഡ്‌സൈസ് എസ്‌യുവി വിപണിയിലെത്തിക്കാൻ ഒരുങ്ങുന്നു. ബയോണിനെ അടിസ്ഥാനമാക്കി ബിസി4ഐ എന്ന കോഡ് നാമത്തിൽ വികസിപ്പിക്കുന്ന ഈ വാഹനം വെന്യുവിനും ക്രെറ്റയ്ക്കും ഇടയിലായിരിക്കും സ്ഥാനം പിടിക്കുക. സിഎൻജി ഓപ്ഷൻ, ലെവൽ 2 എഡിഎഎസ് തുടങ്ങിയ ഫീച്ചറുകളോടെ 2026-ൽ വാഹനം പ്രതീക്ഷിക്കാം.

items.headline: How much air conditioning usage actually prevents heat deaths?
items.teaser: How protective is air conditioning in preventing deaths amid soaring temperatures and record heat levels? Yale researchers found that AC …
items.story: How protective is air conditioning in preventing deaths amid soaring temperatures and record heat levels? Yale researchers found that AC use cut the number of annual heat-related deaths by half in the U.S., saving more than 5,000 lives a year. However, while AC is a highly effective heat adaptation tool, its protective effects level off once use passes a certain point. On days of extreme heat, risk levels tick up even with use.

items.story: Proteins with exposed arginine can selectively accumulate even on protein-resistant coatings, as reported by researchers from Science Tokyo. Through an in-depth analysis of which proteins adhere and how they adhere to various anti-fouling surfaces, the team found that arginine disrupts the protective water layer that normally blocks adsorption. Their results will help scientists develop safer and more effective biocompatible materials for medical devices, such as stents and advanced biosensors.

items.story: Two widely used zero-calorie sweeteners, sucralose and stevia, may have effects that linger far longer than the sweet taste itself. In mice, researchers found that both sweeteners altered the gut microbiome, reduced beneficial compounds produced by gut bacteria, and changed the activity of genes involved in metabolism and inflammation.
